title: Practice 20: Time in a complex sentence

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Which fits? *Максим Горький, «Дед Архип и Лёнька»*
exercises.ru: А нужно всё это для ___, чтобы больше подавали.
exercises.why: «When a preposition refers to a whole clause, a complex conjunction is used consisting of: 1) the preposition, 2) the pronoun "то" in the case required by the preposition, 3) a linking word»: до того как, перед тем как, о том что, за то что, вместо того чтобы. — DLI, Lesson 92. From Максим Горький, «Дед Архип и Лёнька».

exercises.ru: Хочу за лето, ___ буду здесь, перевести одну книжку с английского.
exercises.why: «Пока is used as an adverb of time and as a conjunction. Пока не (until) is a conjunction … ПОКА НЕ has no negative meaning and the particle НЕ is not translated.» — DLI, Lesson 105. From Антон Чехов, «Три сестры».
